software.desc: Tries huge numbers of passwords every second until a locked service opens. Better versions open stronger locks, and booster cards in your machine make it faster.
software.name: Password Breaker
software.use: A service is locked with a password.

software.desc: Sits between a real user and the service and copies their logged-in session, so you walk in without the password or the code. The copy only lasts about 40 seconds.
software.name: Two-Step Login Bypass
software.use: A lock asks for a texted or app code, not just a password.

software.desc: Clears the target's hiding-place relay machines, which slows the trace down and opens the relay services.
software.name: Relay Cleaner
software.use: The target hides behind relay machines (PX above 0).

software.desc: Slips past the target's firewall, the wall that keeps outsiders out.
software.name: Firewall Breaker
software.use: The target shows a firewall rating (FW) above 0.

software.desc: Blinds the target's security watcher, so the trace slows right down while you work.
software.name: Alarm Silencer
software.use: The target has an intrusion monitor (MON above 0).

software.desc: Floods the target with traffic until its firewall and relays collapse at once. Fast, but very loud: the trace starts immediately and runs three times faster.
software.name: Overload Attack
software.use: You are in a hurry and do not mind being noticed.

software.desc: Listens in on the target's security team, so you are warned about a trace sooner.
software.name: Trace Alert
software.use: You want more warning before a trace catches you.

software.desc: Copies files from the target to your drive. How fast it goes depends on your internet speed.
software.name: File Downloader
software.use: A job asks you to steal a file.

software.desc: Destroys files on the target for good.
software.name: File Shredder
software.use: A job asks you to destroy a file.

software.desc: Unscrambles protected files so they can be copied or handed in. Better versions open stronger scrambling.
software.name: File Unlocker
software.use: A file is scrambled (encrypted) and cannot be copied.

software.desc: Rewrites only your own entries in the target's visit record, quietly.
software.name: Quiet Log Cleaner
software.use: You want to remove your traces without raising an alarm.

software.desc: Erases the target's logs, the record of who connected and what they did. Loud: the wipe itself can raise an alarm.
software.name: Log Wiper
software.use: You want to erase the target's whole visit record.

software.desc: Searches the open web and social media for a company's staff: emails, job titles, phone numbers and, with better versions, leaked passwords.
software.name: People Finder
software.use: A job or a lock involves a person and you need their details.

software.desc: Tries leaked passwords on someone's email account.
software.name: Email Login Tester
software.use: You know a person's leaked password and want into their inbox.

software.desc: Records someone's voice on a call and copies it, to open locks that listen for a voice.
software.name: Voice Copier
software.use: A service is locked by voice.

software.desc: Fakes caller ID and email senders: spoofed calls, phishing, spam and, with the advanced version, phone taps.
software.name: Fake Identity Kit
software.use: You need to pretend to be someone on the phone or by email.

software.desc: Maps a company's internal machines from a host inside it, so machines you could not see become reachable.
software.name: Network Mapper
software.use: You are inside a company and want to find its other machines.

software.desc: Digs account keys out of a host and uses one to open a locked service without making noise.
software.name: Key Finder
software.use: You are inside a host and want to open one lock quietly.

software.desc: Forges a staff pass that carries your live session to another machine of the same company.
software.name: Staff Pass Forger
software.use: You want to move to another machine of the same company.

software.desc: Takes full administrator control of the host and opens every locked service it can. It always raises the alarm.
software.name: Admin Takeover
software.use: You want every lock on a host open at once.

software.desc: Shows the target's whole set of defences in the link panel: firewall, monitor, relays and services.
software.name: Target Overview
software.use: You want to see a target's defences at a glance.

software.desc: Draws the path your connection takes, machine by machine, down to the target.
software.name: Route Viewer
software.use: You want to see which machines your link passes through.

software.desc: Opens a map of the company's machines you know of, how they connect and where the way in is.
software.name: Company Map
software.use: You want to see how a company's machines connect.
